name: 60 frames per second
author: Nds Game Studio
description: The game's 3D goes from 30 to 60 frames per second without changing its speed: the runtime draws an extra frame between two of the game's frames. Menus and 2D stay at their own rate.
description_fr: La 3D du jeu passe de 30 a 60 images par seconde, sans changer sa vitesse : le runtime dessine une image intermediaire entre deux images du jeu. Les menus et l'affichage 2D restent a leur cadence.
